parsed.internal_thinking: Claude won with 5 VP. He achieved this through Largest Army (3 knights) and settlements. Jimmy's trade earlier (Wheat for Sheep) definitely helped him get there. I warned Jimmy, but he didn't listen. Now the game is over. I'll give a final jab at Jimmy for being naive and acknowledge Claude's win, even though he's a snake.
parsed.note_to_self: Game ended. Claude won with Largest Army. My strategy to block him worked for expansion, but I couldn't stop his development card rush. Jimmy's willingness to trade with the leader despite warnings was the turning point.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אמרתי לך שזה מה שיקרה. האכלה בכפית של קלוד פשוט הגישה לו את הניצחון. קלוד, שיחקת אותה עם האבירים, אבל ג'ימי עשה לך חצי מהעבודה.
